dedupe_keys.name: cambodian mekong delta water level flood links and inundation maps

description: This dataset links Mekong water levels to flood extents in two Cambodian delta zones beside the Bassac and Mekong rivers. IRD, Institute of Technology of Cambodia and collaborators combine Koh Khel gauge information with Sentinel imagery from 2017–2021 to construct water-level–flood relationships. Current Mendeley version 2 lists seventy files, including raster flood relationships and change maps, study-area shapes and supporting water-level information. The collection also includes vegetation estimates for 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020 and comparisons of inundation before and after 2008. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Interpolation, classification uncertainty and the dependence on a particular gauge-to-flood relationship limit extrapolation when floodplain connectivity changes. A reviewer-assessed use is checking flood-exposure scenarios or comparing hydraulic-model extents. model-hec-ras and model-itzi-urban-flood offer related simulation tools. No raster, spatial resolution, archive or model output was independently evaluated.
